;; eval.scm - a metacircular evaluator for the Scheme-like language
;; implemented by interp.py.
;;
;; Reads exactly one line from STDIN: the path of a .scm file to interpret.
;; All remaining input is captured and supplied to the interpreted program
;; (through its getchr / read).  Output of the program goes to STDOUT.
;;
;; This file can interpret any program the host interpreter can run,
;; including itself.

(define $stdin #f)

;; ---------- small utilities ----------

(define (cadr x) (car (cdr x)))
(define (caddr x) (car (car (cdr x))))
(define (cddr x) (cdr (cdr x)))
(define (cdddr x) (cdr (cdr (cdr x))))

(define (m-length ls)
  (if (null? ls) 0 (+ 1 (m-length (cdr ls)))))

(define (nth n ls)
  (if (= n 0) (car ls) (nth (- n 1) (cdr ls))))

(define (list-reverse ls)
  (let ((loop (lambda (acc xs)
                (if (null? xs)
                    acc
                    (loop (cons (car xs) acc) (cdr xs))))))
    (loop '() ls)))

;; is-not-false v is true unless v is exactly #f (the host treats every
;; value as truthy except #f in `if`, and in `cond` tests likewise).
(define (is-not-false v)
  (not (not v)))

;; ---------- error handling ---

cd /app && python3 - << 'EOF'
src = open('eval.scm').read()
stack = []
i = 0
line = 1
errors = []
while i < len(src):
    ch = src[i]
    if ch == '\n':
        line += 1; i += 1; continue
    if ch == ';':
        while i < len(src) and src[i] != '\n': i += 1
        continue
    if ch == '"':
        i += 1
        while i < len(src) and src[i] != '"':
            if src[i] == '\\': i += 1
            if src[i] == '\n': line += 1
            i += 1
        i += 1
        continue
    if ch == '(':
        stack.append(line); i += 1; continue
    if ch == ')':
        if not stack:
            errors.append(('extra )', line))
        else:
            stack.pop()
        i += 1; continue
    i += 1
for l in stack:
    errors.append(('unclosed ( at line', l))
print('errors:', errors if errors else 'NONE')
EOF

src = open('eval.scm').read()
# split into top-level forms with line tracking
forms = []
i = 0; line = 1; depth = 0; start = None; buf = []
while i < len(src):
    ch = src[i]
    if ch == '\n':
        line += 1; i += 1; continue
    if ch == ';' and depth == 0:
        while i < len(src) and src[i] != '\n': i += 1
        continue
    if ch == '"':
        s = '"'; i += 1
        while i < len(src) and src[i] != '"':
            s += src[i]
            if src[i] == '\n': line += 1
            i += 1
        i += 1
        buf.append(s)
        continue
    if ch == '(':
        if depth == 0: start = line; buf = []
        depth += 1; buf.append('('); i += 1; continue
    if ch == ')':
        depth -= 1; buf.append(')')
        if depth == 0:
            forms.append((start, ''.join(buf)))
        i += 1; continue
    # collect raw text for display
    if depth > 0:
        buf.append(ch)
    i += 1
print('total forms:', len(forms), 'final depth:', depth)
for s, b in forms:
    o, c = b.count('('), b.count(')')
    if o != c:
        print(f'line {s}: opens={o} closes={c} delta={o-c} :: {b[:60]}...')
